draw: census: all 85 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: The proposal artifact is canonically serialised as JSON with recursively sorted keys and no whitespace, and those exact bytes are persisted as proposal_canon.json in the run's scratch directory so a third party can hash the file directly rather than reconstruct it; hProposal is computed as sha256(proposal_canon.json) = 966701d66b878a3be114abbd340639e4032bc8cf1d22fe0af46656cceaa79886, and the salt 916c35631d8a068f410fdb2929f9bd2f31b3254245ab07eef67c2d35a6b211c9 supplied for this SALTED-mode round is concatenated with hProposal (hProposal || salt) and hashed again with sha256 to yield seedHex = a5ee92aa29a1e27e4fd925c7b6dca55ce2f8ed3e4e94d58265b5ab8ed0678b76; since the round is a census over census.json, the witness draw is not a subset-selection from the seed but simply the full, ordered enumeration of all 85 census entries, so any auditor can independently reproduce hProposal via sha256sum on the persisted proposal_canon.json, reproduce seedHex via sha256(hProposal||salt), and reproduce the draw by reading census.json in order, with no access to this session.
